page.layout: One scan: a photograph of a closed book seen edge-on (the text block between two cream-coloured boards or wrappers). No printed text on the page.
page.notes: The image shows the closed book from the side: a cream-coloured cover or wrapper at top and bottom, and the browned page edges of the text block between them. The only words are the digitiser's credit lines in the black strip at the foot ("Early European Books, Copyright © 2012 ProQuest LLC. Images reproduced by courtesy of the Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Firenze. CFMAGL 2.6.498"). These are not printed on the book and are left out. No page is transcribed.
